description:
At the heart of Seventh-day Adventism lies the Great Controversy Worldview-a unique framework shaped by Ellen G. White's 19th-century visions. This worldview brings with it numerous extra-biblical details that aren't found in Scripture but are essential for the Adventist interpretation of the Bible to hold together. It's all part of the same package.  

I am joined by former Adventist Mike Colburn, and we're opening the floor to any Seventh-day Adventist who wants to change our minds. Can anyone show us that this worldview is supported strictly from the bible? Let's have an honest and open conversation.
